title: Pramana: A Composable, Domain-Specific Backend for Empirical Networking Research
abstract: arXiv:2607.26352v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Empirical networking research often tests a hypothesis with data the study itself generates, so accelerating this research requires shortening the time from forming a hypothesis to generating that data. Consider whether a bulk BBR download fairly shares its bottleneck with a Google Meet call. Testing this requires configuring a realistic bottleneck link, running the BBR transfer and the Meet call together, and collecting the call's quality metrics. Today a researcher builds this setup from scratch for each new idea; this delay from idea to data is the ideation-to-data gap. AI agents already propose hypotheses faster than researchers can generate data to test them. Closing the gap needs a backend that generates the data for each new hypothesis on demand, without a new setup.   We envision Pramana, a composable backend for networking research designed as a thin waist, with research intents above it and execution substrates below.

translated_title: Pramana：一个面向实证网络研究的可组合、领域专用后端
translated_abstract: 实证网络研究通常需要用研究本身生成的数据来检验假设，因此加速这类研究的关键在于缩短从形成假设到生成数据所需的时间。例如，考虑一个批量BBR下载是否与Google Meet通话公平共享瓶颈带宽：测试这一假设需要配置一条真实的瓶颈链路、同时运行BBR传输和Meet通话，并收集该通话的质量指标。如今，研究人员不得不为每一个新想法从头搭建这样的实验环境，这种从想法到数据的延迟被称为“构思到数据鸿沟”。AI智能体提出假设的速度已经超过研究人员生成数据来验证它们的速度，弥合这一鸿沟需要一个能够按需为每个新假设生成数据、而无需重新搭建环境的后端。我们提出了Pramana的构想——一个面向网络研究的可组合后端，它采用“细腰”架构设计：其上层是研究意图，其下层是执行基底。
tldr: 论文提出Pramana——一个采用细腰架构（上层为研究意图、下层为执行基底）的可组合网络研究后端，旨在按需自动为每个新假设生成实验数据，以弥合AI快速提出假设与人工搭建实验之间的“构思到数据鸿沟”。
en_tdlr: This paper envisions Pramana, a composable thin-waist backend for empirical networking research that generates experimental data on demand for each new hypothesis, closing the ideation-to-data gap in the era of AI-driven hypothesis generation.
